items.title: Monolithic Power Systems (NASDAQ: MPWR, mps.com) By pixelleaks
items.detail: Power semiconductors (channel sales) · USA Full data leak: 2026-11-30 22:21 UTC This disclosure concerns a verified set of records from an organization in the Power semiconductors (channel sales) sector. The material scheduled for publication comprises a set of business records, including personnel, financial, client, intellectual property, and operational material. Representative records have been examined and verified as genuine. Publication would make the records publicly available and would carry regulatory, competitive, and reputational consequences for the organization. Once published, the complete data set can be examined, downloaded, and redistributed without restriction. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.
